reader.requirement: At --std 85, every store into an elementary alphabetic or alphanumeric receiving item described with JUSTIFIED (MOVE, the implicit MOVE of READ/RETURN INTO, UNSTRING, INITIALIZE REPLACING, a group or numeric sender) truncates the sender's leftmost characters when the sender is larger and right-aligns with left space fill when the receiver is larger; a reference-modified receiver is an item without JUSTIFIED (IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR5) and VALUE initialization is unaffected (VI.5.15.4 GR1c).

edition-consulted.switches: whether JUSTIFIED is a reserved word: true at all four editions

reader.edition-search: Grepped MoveEmitter.cs, ReceivingStore.cs, the RuntimeApi Str* members, CobolString.Store and DataBinder's justifiedClause arm for EditionContext|CobolVersion|ConstructRegistry|DialectBehavior|DialectLevel: none. The grammar rule justifiedClause (CobolData.g4) has no edition predicate; Validation/ has no Justified reference.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb339_into_current_record_85 covers READ/RETURN INTO a JUSTIFIED receiver only; MOVE of literals, groups, numeric and signed senders, ODO group senders, subscripted and multiple receivers, UNSTRING, INITIALIZE and the reference-modified receiver are not exercised there.

reader.notes: One alignment dispatch (StrStoreAligned) serves MOVE, READ/RETURN INTO, UNSTRING and INITIALIZE; nothing on the path reads the edition and the 1985 range (alphabetic and alphanumeric only) is a subset of what the code handles. Diagnostics on the refusal half cite §2023 at --std 85.
